home.subtitle: Start everyday office work, inspect current tasks, and manage the information your assistant can use.
home.startHint: Choose an example to place a complete instruction in the task box. Nothing runs until you send it.

reimbursement.title: Prepare a reimbursement package
reimbursement.prompt: Organize the attached invoices and receipts into a reimbursement checklist. Flag missing dates, amounts, categories, or approvals, and create a clear summary for me to review before submission.

requirements.title: Turn notes into requirements
requirements.prompt: Turn the attached notes into a requirements document with goals, users, scope, acceptance criteria, open questions, and risks. Mark every assumption and do not invent missing facts.

data.title: Analyze a data file
data.prompt: Analyze the attached spreadsheet. Check data quality first, then summarize key changes, unusual values, and conclusions supported by the data. Create a concise table of findings.

market.title: Prepare a market brief
market.prompt: Prepare a market brief for the topic I provide. Separate sourced facts from inference, compare the main alternatives, and list the evidence and dates behind each important conclusion.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: These are your real conversations and their current state.
tasks.manageHint: Open a task to inspect its messages and state. Stop an active run, add files, or amend requirements in the conversation so the existing execution and history controls are preserved.

reasons.CORE_CAPACITY_WAIT: Accepted and waiting for an available employee execution environment.
reasons.BACKGROUND_AUTHORIZATION_UNAVAILABLE: Background authorization could not be saved. This execution was not started; sign in again or contact your administrator.
reasons.TASK_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED: Employee or task authorization was revoked. Restricted execution has stopped.
reasons.TASK_QUEUE_WAIT_EXPIRED: The durable queue wait limit was reached. The task is retained; retry when capacity is available.
reasons.SERVICE_RESTART_REVIEW_BEFORE_RESUME: The service restarted during execution. Review saved outputs and uncertain operations before continuing.
reasons.TASK_RUNTIME_INTERRUPTED: The execution environment was interrupted. Saved task data and outputs are retained.
reasons.TASK_ACCEPTANCE_UNCERTAIN: The execution acknowledgement is uncertain. Check existing results before any retry.
reasons.REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS_MISSING: Some required deliverables are missing or invalid. Available files are shown; retry the unfinished steps.
reasons.MODEL_EXECUTION_FAILED: The model execution failed. Saved outputs are retained.
reasons.TOOL_STEPS_UNFINISHED: Some tools failed. Review the steps and retry the unfinished portion.
reasons.RESULT_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The available execution evidence does not establish completion. Review and continue.
reasons.TASK_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE: Execution could not be verified. Review details and retry safely.
reasons.USER_CANCELLED: Cancelled by the employee. Existing outputs are retained.
reasons.USER_CANCEL_REQUESTED: A stop was requested; waiting for the actual execution to stop.
reasons.TASK_EXECUTION_TIME_LIMIT: The execution time limit was reached. Stopping the task and retaining available results.
reasons.RESOURCE_UPDATE_WAIT: Waiting for active work to finish safely and current capabilities to synchronize. The task remains queued.
